name: River City Bank
summary: River City Bank, together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services. The company offers checking, savings, and term certificate accounts. It also provides personal, consumer, commercial real estate, commercial, commercial, agriculture, and residential mortgage loans; and home equity lines of credit. In addition, the company offers cash management services; lockbox, integrated payables, clean energy financing and solutions, and premier banking services; debit and credit cards; and online and mobile banking services.
